arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

translations.en.sahih: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
translations.en.pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
translations.en.yusufali: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila telah datang pertolongan Allah dan kemenangan,

arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
transliteration: Wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah

translations.en.sahih: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
translations.en.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
translations.en.yusufali: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu lihat manusia masuk agama Allah dengan berbondong-bondong,

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
transliteration: Fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba

translations.en.sahih: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
translations.en.pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
translations.en.yusufali: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
translations.id.indonesian: maka bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu dan mohonlah ampun kepada-Nya. Sesungguhnya Dia adalah Maha Penerima taubat.
